result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and a marked crosswalk. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded and the roadway pavement is in poor condition with visible cracking and patching.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crossing across the main street

hazards.name: Degraded pavement
hazards.description: Significant cracking and uneven asphalt surfaces in the roadway can create tripping hazards or affect vehicle control.
hazards.location_in_image: Lower right and center foreground of the roadway

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Roadway resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the intersection to provide a smooth, predictable surface for all users.

result.summary: The street features wide sidewalks and a mature tree canopy that provides a pleasant buffer for pedestrians in a residential setting. However, the existing crosswalk is significantly faded and lacks active traffic control or warning signage, increasing exposure risk.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The transverse crosswalk lines are heavily worn, making the crossing less conspicuous to approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: There are no stop signs, signals, or pedestrian warning signs at this crossing point.

hazards.name: Road surface degradation
hazards.description: Visible cracking and wear in the asphalt may create uneven surfaces for pedestrians or affect vehicle braking.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Replace the faded transverse lines with continental or ladder-style markings to improve visibility for motorists.

interventions.title: Curb extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian crossing signage
interventions.description: Install warning signs to alert drivers to the presence of a pedestrian crossing area.

result.summary: The intersection features wide, well-maintained sidewalks with tactile warning pads, but lacks marked crosswalks and pedestrian-specific signals. The presence of a one-way street and large street trees may impact visibility and vehicle speeds.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: There are no painted crosswalks at this signalized intersection, which reduces driver awareness of pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway adjacent to the curb ramp

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: A large tree trunk near the corner may partially block the view between drivers and pedestrians waiting to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk near the street

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental or zebra-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian path and increase driver yielding.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear right-of-way information.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, traffic signals, and marked crosswalks near a large school building. However, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures like curb extensions or medians increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic and parking/bike lanes without a refuge island.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Visibility Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner may block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection where cars are parked along the curb.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Upgrade standard parallel line crosswalks to continental or ladder markings to increase visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.
